The image features a bathroom with a white bathtub and a sink. The bathtub is situated next to a mirror, and a red shower curtain is hanging in front of it. The sink is located on the right side of the bathroom, with a towel hanging nearby. 

There are two bottles placed on the countertop, one closer to the sink and the other further away. Additionally, there are two cups, one near the sink and the other closer to the bathtub. A toothbrush can also be seen on the countertop, near the sink.

In addition to the giraffes, there are several birds scattered throughout the scene, adding to the lively atmosphere. The birds are positioned at various heights and distances, some closer to the giraffes and others further away.
